messages.subject: 'breaks' must all be finite
parts:
Hello, 

I sometimes get following error when i try to plot parts of linkage groups with the heatmap function: 

> heatMap(F7_Wex113_map3, "L.1.1.1.2.2", c(100:400))



Error in image.default(..., breaks = breaks, add = add, col = col) : 
  'breaks' must all be finite
In addition: Warning message:
In heatMap(F7_Wex113_map3, "L.1.1.1.2.2", c(100:400)) : Running est.rf.


I am using actually the wrapper function from ASmap, but i guess it is about equal to whats done in Rqtl.
When i inspected the LG, i see a large gap in its middle, created by two markers placed there (probably misplaced).
Plotting heatmap with markers from the left side of the gap works fine, spanning the gap as well but everything right from the gap fails to be plotted. 
Do i need to set breaks in some way? 

Thank you, 
michel

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] 'breaks' must all be finite
parts:
heatMap is from the ASMap package. Talk to the authors of that package.
